errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are "Recall," "Precision," and "F1 Score." This is not alphabetical order, as "F1 Score" would precede "Precision".
The vertical axis does not have a label. The description incorrectly states it is labeled "F1 Score".
The visible range of the y-axis shown in the chart is from 40 to 100, not 0 to 100.
The tick labels on the y-axis are at 20-unit intervals (40, 60, 80, 100), not 10-unit intervals.
The description does not specify the units of the y-axis. Given the context of Recall, Precision, and F1 Score, the units are percentages.
